title: Finite cover with analytically unramified maximal localizations
statement: Let $R$ be a normal Nagata domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], $K$ its fraction field, $x\in K$, $S=R[x]\subseteq K$, $\mathfrak m$ a maximal ideal of $S$, and $A=S_{\mathfrak m}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Assume the following local calculation for every normal Nagata domain $R\prime$ and its fraction field $K\prime$: if $R\prime$ and $R\prime[y]$ are Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and a maximal ideal $\mathfrak q$ of $R\prime[y]$ contains $y$, then $R\prime[y]_{\mathfrak q}$ is analytically unramified [def-weil-pbc-analytically-unramified]. Then there exists a Noetherian domain $B$ with an injective $A$-algebra map, finite as an $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], such that (i) for some nonzero $f\in B$, every prime localization of $B_f$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] is a normal domain, and (ii) every maximal localization of $B$ is analytically unramified. In Lean, the quantified local-calculation rings and the witness B lie in Type(max u v); the finite splitting construction fits in this universe.

proof.text: Use the finite splitting structural cover lemma to obtain the finite injective Noetherian domain cover, its normal principal open, and its generator-containing monogenic maximal-local presentations.

For each maximal ideal q, unpack its local presentation Rprime[y]_n. Apply the supplied local calculation hypothesis to y in n, then transport reducedness of completion through the ring isomorphism using invariance of adic completion. Package the resulting cover.
